title: 100 Series 36" French Door Refrigerator
sub: Anti-fingerprint stainless steel, integrated handles, ice and water at the door
lead: Bosch's 100 Series French door refrigerator in anti-fingerprint stainless steel, at standard depth for 26 cubic feet of room. Ice and filtered water come from the door, and the QuickIce Pro System makes up to 8 lb of ice a day.

features.name: QuickIce Pro System
features.line: Bosch's ice maker turns out up to 8 lb of ice a day. Fill the cooler and still have ice for the glasses.

features.name: Ice and water at the door
features.line: Filtered water and ice without opening a door. Bottle Fill fills a bottle hands-free.

features.name: Standard depth, 26 cubic feet
features.line: Eighteen cubic feet of refrigerator above an eight cubic foot freezer. Room for the weekly shop and the party platter.

features.name: Anti-fingerprint stainless steel
features.line: A finish that guards against fingerprints and smudges, with handles built into the doors.

features.name: Two-tier freezer drawer
features.line: The freezer pulls out as a drawer, with an upper tier for what you reach for most.

also: Two crisper drawers and a full-width chiller drawer
Six door bins, two of them gallon size
UltraClarityPro water filter, first cartridge included
Wi-Fi with Home Connect, there if you want it: check and adjust it from a phone
specs: QuickIce Pro System, up to 8 lb a day
